name: Arzúa to O Pedrouzo
notes: O Pedrouzo is also written Pedrouzo or Arca (general knowledge; concello O Pino). Photon lists several hamlets called O Pedrouzo in Galicia (Boqueixón, Santiso, Ordes, Trazo, Vilasantar); the one used (node 766526727) is the only one on the Camino, 16.4 km west-south-west of Arzúa and 15.2 km from Santiago in straight lines. A Rúa also has two hits near O Pedrouzo: the used node 766526856 is 1.4 km from O Pedrouzo, the other one (42.95795,-8.37634) is 6 km north and not on the Camino. A Salceda, A Brea and Santa Irene are hamlet nodes in O Pino; A Calzada, Calle and Boavista (between Arzúa and A Salceda) were not looked up.
